title: Consolidator: Learning Persistent Routed Memory Across Context Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2608.11701v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Copying short-term memory (STM) into a slower store can preserve state across a context boundary, but persistence alone does not ensure that the retained state influences subsequent memory access. We test this distinction in a Phasor Memory Network (PMNet) using Consolidator, a shared slot-local operator that transforms routed STM before accumulating it into long-term memory (LTM), without replaying the source tokens. After each consolidation, the KV cache and STM are cleared. The retained LTM can still be read and is also fed into the hierarchical router, thereby conditioning which explicit-memory slots subsequent inputs access. We evaluate this mechanism on a two-segment modulo-10 mapping task in which the second segment updates the mapping at the same memory address. Following a second consolidation and reset, a held-out query must recover the updated mapping from LTM. The backbone and memory interface are frozen, leaving only 12.35

translated_title: 整合器：跨上下文边界学习持久路由记忆
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11701v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：将短期记忆（STM）复制到较慢的存储中可以跨上下文边界保留状态，但仅靠持久性并不能确保保留的状态影响后续的内存访问。我们在一个相位记忆网络（PMNet）中测试了这一区别，使用整合器（Consolidator），这是一种共享的槽位局部操作符，在将路由后的STM累积到长期记忆（LTM）之前对其进行变换，而无需重放源标记。每次整合后，KV缓存和STM都会被清除。保留的LTM仍然可以被读取，并且也被馈送到分层路由器中，从而调节后续输入访问哪些显式记忆槽位。我们在一个两段式模10映射任务上评估了这一机制，其中第二段在同一内存地址更新映射。在第二次整合和重置后，一个保留的查询必须从LTM中恢复更新后的映射。骨干网络和记忆接口被冻结，仅留下12.35（个参数可训练）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为整合器（Consolidator）的机制，通过将短期记忆转换并累积到长期记忆中，无需重放源标记即可跨上下文边界保持路由记忆，并在两段式映射任务中验证了其能恢复更新后的映射。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mechanism called Consolidator that transforms and accumulates short-term memory into long-term memory without replaying source tokens, enabling persistent routed memory across context boundaries and demonstrating recovery of updated mappings in a two-segment task.
